findings.label: DB runtime verification deferred
findings.detail: Incident de-dup, deadline, ownership 403s, autosave, heartbeat staleness, and CSV export have no executed evidence (no project venv, no MySQL in-env). Run the documented manual smoke tests and `python -m pytest tests/test_violation_engine.py` in the deploy-compatible venv before sign-off.

findings.label: Client reload uses localStorage only
findings.detail: restoreDraftSelections() reads localStorage, never the server draft_answers, so resuming on a different browser/device shows no prior selections. Score safety still holds via the /submit server-side draft fallback; wire the server draft into the render if cross-device resume UX is wanted.

findings.label: Autosave drops option letters beyond A-D
findings.detail: /autosave keeps only values in ('A','B','C','D'). Any MCQ with more than four options would not persist those selections to the draft (the live /submit POST still captures them). Confirm no assessment uses >4 options, or widen the allowed set.

findings.label: warning_count semantics changed
findings.detail: warning_count now increments once per distinct-incident warn rather than only on the first warning. Intended under the new engine; confirm the HR dashboard reading of warning_count expects a running count.

findings.label: Second-granularity de-dup boundary
findings.detail: TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,...)*1000 vs warning_cooldown_ms means a continuous incident whose POST lands just over the 4.5s window can occasionally produce a second row. Low impact; acceptable per design's second-granularity math.
